subject: the 12 fw1 Fiats quarantined 2026-08-09 for 'tyres render body-white'
why: The 12 were quarantined on their wave audit sheet in car-meshes/audit/fiat/<uid>.jpg.
Commit 082ef0f then proved the wave sheet is NOT a valid witness for tyre colour:
on peugeot-205-pw1-v1 the sheet shows a white tyre on a dark wheel while the SHIPPED
glb has the tyre material at baseColor 0.02 on a white steel wheel -- the render
worker picks a body material heuristically at render time and was repainting the
tyre. 27 sheet-based tyre-fails were retracted on that evidence; these 12 rest on
the same discredited evidence and are re-tested here from the shipped asset only.
method: No poster exists for any fw1 entry (posterUrl and turntableUrl are null for all 12),
and platform/resolver/index.ts serves desktopGlbUrl straight to the viewer -- so the
SHIPPED GLB's own materials are literally what a customer sees. No render worker sits
between the asset and the user, which is what makes the glTF material decisive here
1. glTF: resolved which material the TYRE RING GEOMETRY actually uses, not merely
which materials exist -- clustered the wheel objects and read the Principled base
colour of the parts at the outer radius (a material NAMED 'tire' proves nothing;
toyota-corolla-cross shipped eight variants that edited an invisible material).
2. Local Blender render of the shipped glb (CPU Cycles, no GPU, no RunPod job): a
front-3/4 full car, a profile, and a close-up framed on the near wheel using the
tyre geometry's own centroid. Tread judged in 3/4, never the sidewall in profile.
3. Four APPROVED fw1 Fiats rendered in the identical rig as same-scale controls
(126 and 600-1967 carry the byte-identical `tire` material), because CLAUDE.md
records that a mid-grey tyre under a one-sided key reads as white without one.
4. Magenta cross-check on fiat-124-1966: the `tire` material was rewritten to magenta
in the shipped glb and re-rendered; the whole tyre turned magenta, proving the
rubber material really is bound to the tyre geometry.
rigCorrection: The FIRST version of this audit's rig rendered fiat-124-1966's tyre pure WHITE and
would have re-confirmed the quarantine. It was wrong: the magenta control came back
PASTEL PINK, proving the rig was clipping. Cause was Blender 4's default AgX view
transform plus inherited light energies. Fixed to Standard transform + LIGHTSCALE=0.10
and verified numerically -- the 0.22 world background lands on sRGB 129 (predicted 130)
and 0% of pixels clip. Every verdict below is from the corrected rig.
originalCallWasWrong: all 12 -- the sheets do show white tyres, but on the discredited render path

verdicts.evidence: Dark grey tyre with a visible tread band, white hubcap. This is the car the MAGENTA CROSS-CHECK was run on: rewriting `tire` to magenta turned the entire tyre magenta and left the hubcap white, so the dark rubber material is provably on the tyre geometry.

verdicts.evidence: Body renders BLUE and the tyre renders neutral dark grey/black. A body-coloured tyre would be blue; it is not. Decisive on its own.
